tools.name: judge_idea
tools.description: Judge a startup or side-project idea. Returns a verdict (verdict KILL, FIX or SHIP, shown as verdict_label KILL IT, FIX IT or SHIP IT), an overall score, the best_signal, the biggest_risk and the eight scored dimensions. If the idea is too vague to judge, needs_detail is true and verdict, verdict_la

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: How many ideas Kill My Idea has analyzed so far and how many were killed, fixed or shipped. Cached for 5 minutes.
